Etcura v0.0.4 — safer editing, read-only connections, and more reliable browsing

## New: read-only connections

- Enable **Read-only connection** in a connection profile to browse and inspect data with writes disabled. The app enforces this setting for create, overwrite, save, and delete.
- Scope write actions to the connection session where they started. Switching or reconnecting requires opening the key again before making changes.

## Fixes

- Editing a value preserves its existing lease and returns the revision written by the transaction.
- Single-key delete and overwrite check the revision shown at confirmation. If another client changes the key, Etcura reports a conflict.
- Connection checks can succeed through a healthy endpoint when another configured endpoint is unavailable. The client stays active after the initial connection check finishes.
- Directory pagination advances correctly when a batch contains both subdirectories and leaf keys. Responses from an older connection or tree refresh no longer replace the current tree.
- Switching to a decoded view preserves the editable text or binary buffer.

SHA-256 checksums are attached alongside each archive (`*.sha256`).

## Install

- **macOS** — unzip and drag `etcura.app` into /Applications. Builds use ad-hoc signing. If Gatekeeper blocks first launch, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/SH-Wang123/etcura/blob/v0.0.4/README.en.md#download--install-releases-recommended-for-most-users).
- **Windows** — unzip and run `etcura.exe`. The app requires the WebView2 Runtime. See the [Windows guide](https://github.com/SH-Wang123/etcura/blob/v0.0.4/docs/WINDOWS.md) for help.
- **Linux** — unzip and run `./etcura`. The build requires GTK3 and WebKitGTK 4.1.

## 中文

Etcura v0.0.4 增加**只读连接**，并修复写入、连接切换和目录分页的问题。

**只读连接**

- 在连接配置中启用「只读连接」后，仍可浏览和查看数据。应用会拦截新建、覆盖、保存和删除。
- 写操作绑定到发起时的连接会话。切换集群或重新连接后，需要重新打开 key 再操作。

**修复**

- 修改 value 时保留已有 Lease，并返回本次事务写入的 revision。
- 删除和覆盖按确认时显示的 revision 校验，遇到并发修改时提示冲突。
- 配置多个 endpoint 时，只要有可用节点即可通过连接检查。连接检查结束后，客户端继续保持可用。
- 修复子目录与叶子 key 混排时的分页重复问题，避免旧连接或旧刷新结果回填到当前目录树。
- 切换到解码视图时保留文本或二进制编辑草稿。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SH-Wang123/etcura/compare/v0.0.3...v0.0.4
